name.ja: ３０ＭＭ 1/144 EXM-A9sg スピナティオ (将軍仕様)

description.ja: エグザマクスの登場により、地球、宇宙、惑星、あらゆる場所に戦場が広がっていった。
description.en: With the appearance of Examacus, battlefields have spread across the Earth, space, and planets.

description.ja: 数多の量産機が投入されたその戦場の中で、勝敗を左右したとされる機体たちがあった。
description.en: Among the many mass-produced aircraft that were introduced into the battlefield, there were some that were said to have a decisive influence on victory or defeat.

description.ja: これは英雄たちの記録である。
description.en: This is a record of heroes.

description.ja: ３０ＭＭ 1/144 EXM-A9sg SPINATIO (SHOGUN TYPE)
description.en: 30MM 1/144 EXM-A9sg SPINATIO (SHOGUN TYPE)

description.ja: ３０ＭＭ 1/144 EXM-A9sg スピナティオ (将軍仕様)
description.en: 30MM 1/144 EXM-A9sg Spinatio (General specification)

description.ja: 『30 MINUTES MISSIONS ANOTHER EXAMACS PLAN』
description.en: 『30 MINUTES MISSIONS ANOTHER EXAMACS PLAN』

description.ja: https://bandai-hobby.net/site/30mmaep/
description.en: https://bandai-hobby.net/site/30mmaep/

description.ja: 『30 MINUTES MISSIONS ANOTHER EXAMACS PLAN』よりEXM-A9sg スピナティオ (将軍仕様)が登場。
description.en: EXM-A9sg Spinatio (General specification) is now available from "30 MINUTES MISSIONS ANOTHER EXAMACS PLAN".

description.ja: 将軍仕様のアーマー各種、大太刀が新規造形で付属。真紅と黒の専用カラーリングを採用し、新規の水転写式デカールが付属。
description.en: A variety of general-specific armor and a newly sculpted Odachi sword are included. Adopts a special coloring of crimson and black, and comes with a new water transfer decal.

description.ja: さらに様々なカスタマイズ用パーツを同梱。『30MINUTES MISSIONS』の魅力が詰まったオールインワンセット。
description.en: Furthermore, various customization parts are included. An all-in-one set packed with the charm of "30 MINUTES MISSIONS".

description.ja: ●　デザイナー海老川兼武氏 監修！の専用装備を新規造形で立体化
description.en: ● Supervised by designer Kanetake Ebikawa! The special equipment is three-dimensionalized with new modeling.

description.ja: デザイナー海老川兼武氏監修の機体を立体化。
description.en: Three-dimensional version of the aircraft supervised by designer Kanetake Ebikawa.

description.ja: 強化された本機には頭部アーマー、胸部・背部アーマー、肩部アーマー、膝部アーマー、スタビライザー、大太刀が新規で同梱。
description.en: This strengthened machine comes with new head armor, chest/back armor, shoulder armor, knee armor, stabilizer, and large sword.

description.ja: 頭部アーマーの額部分は接続位置を変更する事で「戦闘モード」と「待機モード」を選択可能。
description.en: By changing the connection position of the forehead part of the head armor, you can select "battle mode " or " standby mode".

description.ja: ●　新規デザインの水転写式デカールが付属
description.en: ● Newly designed water transfer decal included.

description.ja: 本機体の専用マーキングや、シリーズ初の漢字デカール等を収録した、新規デザインの水転写式デカールが付属。
description.en: Comes with a newly designed water transfer decal that includes exclusive markings for this unit and the first kanji decal in the series.

description.ja: ●　専用カラーリング仕様で将軍機を商品化
description.en: ● Commercialization of the Shogun's aircraft with special coloring specifications

description.ja: 本体及びオプションパーツの成形色は、専用カラーリングを採用。
description.en: The molding color of the main body and optional parts uses a special coloring.

description.ja: 将軍機の特殊な機体色を表現。
description.en: Expressing the special body color of the Shogun's aircraft.

description.ja: ●　自分専用にカスタマイズ可能！豊富なカスタマイズ用パーツが付属。
description.en: ● Customizable for your own use! Comes with a wide variety of customization parts.

description.ja: 本体を構成するパーツの他、カスタマイズ用パーツも付属。
description.en: In addition to the parts that make up the main body, customization parts are also included.

description.ja: 自分専用機へのカスタマイズも可能なオールインワンセット！
description.en: An all-in-one set that allows you to customize your own machine!

description.ja: セット内容 ： スピナティオ (将軍仕様) ／ カスタマイズ用パーツ一式 ／ 水転写式デカール
description.en: Set contents: Spinatio (general specification) / complete set of customization parts / water slide decal
